title: feat(threadmill)!: thread-mill tool kinds and a reworked helical thread-milling operation
body:
## What changed

First slice of #894: thread mills can be stored, and an internal thread-milling operation verifies clean and posts helical G2/G3 with Z.

**Tool model**
- Two new tool kinds: `thread_mill` (multi-form: rows of teeth at one pitch) and `thread_mill_single` (single-form: one row, a pitch range). They read diameter (across the crests), form angle (`tip_angle`), `pitch`, cutting length (`flute_len`), flutes and shank; a single-form mill also reads the new `pitch_min` key. Sanity law, pitch door and form door live in `crates/tools/src/thread_mill.rs`.
- Library and project file round-trip (`pitch_min` is written only when set; additive, no project-version step), the tool editor (kind list, pitch / pitch range / form angle rows, a sane draft when the kind is picked), the tree's kind name, the operation digest, and two starter-catalog tools (`TM-0600-P125`, `TMS-0600-P050-150`).
- The program simulation sweeps a thread mill at its tooth roots, the reading a tap already has (#266).

**Thread operation** (the existing `Thread` kind, reworked)
- The kernel is rewritten (`machining2d/thread_mill.rs`, `thread_ride.rs`): radial passes are full helices (equal steps, the last on the thread depth), a single-form mill winds one turn per thread, a multi-form mill makes one revolution per level; tangential lead-in / lead-out arcs that keep the helix's axial rate; climb / conventional and right / left hand by the handbook rule; the tip never below the floor, no rapid below the feature's top; the feed stated at the cutting edge and programmed at the tool centre.
- New operation fields `pitch` (optional: unstated reads a multi-form mill's own) and `hand`; both in the file, the page (Passes tab) and the MCP `add_operation` / `edit_operation` params.
- Refusals by name when the operation is created, edited, retyped or re-tooled, and again at generate: a pitch outside a single-form mill's range, a pitch other than a multi-form mill's, a form angle other than 60 degrees, an infeed past the thread depth, a mill no smaller than a hole's minor diameter, a zero / negative / non-finite pitch. A single-form mill with the pitch not stated yet is an unfinished operation (a new Thread operation starts that way): it may be made and edited, and generate refuses it by name.
- Gouge laws: the tooth crests are judged against the thread's major circle (tangency law), the body under the teeth against the part solid with no allowance at the tip (solid law). The crossing law stands down for Thread only (passes retrace one helix by design).

**Why the kernel was rewritten rather than extended** - on `main` no Thread operation can post: the old ride retraces itself (the crossing law convicts every pair) and stands past the hole rim (the tangency law convicts every move). It also deepened the radius turn by turn while descending, so the top threads were shallower than the bottom ones, and its "climb" wound counter-clockwise while descending, which is a left-hand helix. Details and sources: `docs/decisions/894-thread-mill.md`.

## Breaking

- A `Thread` operation no longer accepts a Tap-kind tool (`tool_law::THREAD_MILL` was `[Tap]`). An existing one shows the tool law's after-state and refuses to generate or post until its tool is re-kinded as a thread mill.
- Every existing `Thread` operation reads Stale once (its digest now carries pitch and hand) and regenerates to the new ride.
- `Tool` gains the field `pitch_min`: a branch that builds a full `Tool { .. }` literal needs `pitch_min: 0.0` after it merges main.

## How tested

Fork synced at v0.17.0 (branch cut from upstream/main f490458a).

Quick gate on the final head `d5f32a6a`: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` - tools, motion, app and ui suites, 4 steps, 0 failed (12.3 min; the diff touches the tool model, so the plan is every suite of the four crates). A first run failed to compile one app test (`tests/tool_law.rs`, an exhaustive `ToolKind` match) and was fixed before this head. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Pinning tests:
- `camcraft-tools` (lib): `thread_mill::tests::*` (4) - the two kinds' sanity, the pitch door, the form door.
- `camcraft-motion` (lib): `machining2d::thread_tests::*` (8) - hand and orbit sense for all 16 hand / climb / internal-external / form combinations, equal passes landing on the ISO depth, one shared helix across passes and levels, floor and no-rapid-below-top laws, the lead arcs' form law (a 60-degree tooth never leaves the groove), the centre-feed scaling, a boss never cut past its depth, the refusals.
- `camcraft-app` `--test thread_mill` (8): M8 x 1.25 with the multi-form mill and M8 x 1 with the single-form mill through the command path - no blocking warning, the post gate passes, the program simulation finds no gouge, Fanuc output carries `G03 ... Z ... I ...` blocks; left-hand and conventional variants; a mill whose roots meet the wall is a gouge; a bottom below the blind floor is a gouge; the creation-time refusals; a gated, undoable pitch edit; tool JSON and project-file round trip.
- `camcraft-app` (lib): `operation::thread_op::tests::*` (3) - the crest region, the root cutter, the crossing stand-down is Thread-only.
- `camcraft-app` `--test mill2d_c`: the M2.4 C thread tests, updated to the new ride and tool kind.
- `camcraft-app` `--test mcp`: `thread_milling_over_the_tools`.
- `camcraft-ui` (lib): `egui_app::tool_thread_mill_row::tests::picking_a_thread_mill_kind_seeds_a_sane_tool_and_round_trips`, `egui_app::thread_mill_page_tests::the_thread_page_states_the_pitch_and_the_hand_and_apply_undoes`.
- `camcraft-app` `--test tool_gate` / `--test tool_law`: updated for the new kinds (the Thread row's catalog hint is now `TM-0600-P125`).

Goldens added (none moved):
- `crates/app/tests/golden/thread_mill_internal_single_form.cl`
- `crates/app/tests/golden/thread_mill_internal_multi_form_left_hand.cl`
- `crates/app/tests/golden/thread_mill_external_single_form.cl`
- `crates/app/tests/golden/thread_mill_m8_multi_form.cl`
- `crates/app/tests/golden/thread_mill_m8_fine_single_form.cl`
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/thread_mill_m8_multi_form.nc`

## Known gap (read before merging)

- **An undrilled hole is not refused.** A thread mill is not centre-cutting, and the ride feeds it down the hole's axis. Nothing yet checks that an earlier operation opened the hole: on a part whose hole is modelled, a Thread operation with no drilling before it generates and verifies clean. Before this PR no Thread operation could post at all, so this path is newly reachable. The check needs the stock the earlier operations leave standing (the grid `operation::drill_prior` reads) and is filed as #992 (`bug`, P1). The tests here thread a modelled hole in a solid stock box with no drill before it - they pin the ride and the part laws, not that entry.

## What was not exercised

- External threads at the operation level: the kernel cuts a boss and is pinned by tests and a golden, but the operation always passes `external: false` (no boss recognition or pick, and the static region cannot judge a tool beside a boss). Filed as #985.
- The thread form in the simulation and the tool preview: the stock sim removes the root cylinder only, and the tool draws as the cylinder its crests sweep. Filed as #986.
- Forms other than 60 degrees (Whitworth, NPT taper, trapezoidal) are refused, not cut. Filed as #987.
- Spring passes, unequal pass depths, a stated thread-depth override and M4 (left-hand cutter) climb sense. Filed as #988.
- Posts other than Fanuc were not run on a thread program; the inverted-machine post path already refuses a helical arc by name (`post/invert.rs`) and was not changed.
- The UI rows were compiled and unit-tested through the draft; no pixel snapshot was touched and the release-lane snapshot suite was not run.
- The heavy `--ignored` release lanes and the batch tier's clippy over untouched crates.
- The `camcraft-mcp` skill text does not yet mention the new kinds and fields (a process file; it would need a `PROCESS_VERSION` bump). Filed as #989 (`MCP:`).

Changelog: Thread mills (multi-form and single-form) as tool kinds, and a reworked Thread operation that cuts internal threads by helical interpolation - radial passes, climb / conventional, right / left hand - verifies clean and posts G2/G3 with Z; breaking: a Thread operation no longer accepts a Tap-kind tool.

Effort: max (no escalation)

Refs #894
